text: I. x² - 5x - 6 = 0  II. y² + 20y + 100 = 0. Solve both equations and select the correct relation between x and y.
options: x = y or no relation can be established
explanation: I. x² - 5x - 6 = 0 gives (x + 1)(x - 6) = 0, so x = -1 or 6. II. y² + 20y + 100 = 0 gives (y + 10)(y + 10) = 0, so y = -10 (both roots). Every x is bigger than every y (smallest x is -1, largest y is -10), so x > y. This is stronger than x ≥ y, so x > y is the answer.

text: I. x² - 6x + 9 = 0  II. 3y² - 2y - 21 = 0. Solve both equations and select the correct relation between x and y.

explanation: I. x² - 6x + 9 = 0 gives (x - 3)(x - 3) = 0, so x = 3 (both roots). II. 3y² - 2y - 21 = 0 gives (y - 3)(3y + 7) = 0, so y = 3 or -7/3. The smallest x (3) equals the largest y (3) and no x is smaller, so x ≥ y but not x > y.
